content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who secure less than 04 marks in the Konkani test are not evaluated further Candidates found ineligible at document verification are not considered even after passing the written examination Soliciting or canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Degree in Engineering (Civil/Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental) from a recognized University / Institution; Knowledge of Konkani; 15 years Residence certificate; Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Level 6. Qualification required: Master's Degree in Environmental Sciences from recognized University/ Institutions; Knowledge of Konkani; 15 years Residence certificate; Desirable: Knowledge of Marathi. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Level 6.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Level of Pay: Level 6. Posts are filled on regular basis Waiting list valid up to one year from the date of its preparation

content_sections.heading: How Will GSPCB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (MCQ, 75 marks) Verification of documents Selection strictly on marks in the written examination; no marks for Educational Qualifications Equal marks: older date of birth first, then higher Educational Qualifications Konkani test of 10 marks; minimum 04 marks required for further evaluation Minimum passing marks: Unreserved 45%, OBC 40%, ST/PwD 35%

content_sections.heading: GSPCB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Total 75 marks, duration one and half hour, Multiple Choice Questions Konkani questions will be the first 10 Report 30 minutes before the scheduled examination time Distribution of marks is indicative; minor variations may be made Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour for visual impairment, cerebral palsy and locomotor disabilities

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of Educational Qualification with marksheet of the qualifying examination Valid Employment Exchange, Goa / Valid Employment Registration Card Valid 15 years Residence Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of the State of Goa Birth Certificate Any photo identity proof issued by State Government Valid Caste Certificate (reserved category) and Disabilities Certificate issued by the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online on the portal https://cbes.goa.gov.in by filling the Application Form along with the Declaration. Register/apply with a valid Email-ID and mobile number. Portal is live from 18/11/2026 to 02/12/2026. Submit a separate Application Form for each post, if eligible. No application is accepted after 02/12/2026 or in any other mode.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All communication only on the Email ID given in the Application Form; no hard copy sent Written examination date to be intimated by press note, GSPCB website and local daily Syllabus and scheme of examination to be uploaded shortly on www.goaspcb.gov.in and www.goa.gov.in Candidates needing scribe/reader/lab assistant must inform GSPCB well in advance with Appendix I and II GSPCB reserves the right to change or cancel the recruitment process

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026. Applications opened on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 5 Junior Environmental Engineer (Group 'B' - Non-Gazetted), 6 Junior Environmental Officer (Group 'B', Non-Gazetted).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSPCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years, PwD (SC/ST) 15 years, PwD (OBC) 13 years, Government servants up to 05 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 6 for Junior Environmental Engineer (Group 'B' - Non-Gazetted), Level 6 for Junior Environmental Officer (Group 'B', Non-Gazetted).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Junior Environmental Engineer: Degree in Engineering (Civil/Chemical/Mechanical/Environmental). Junior Environmental Officer: Master's Degree in Environmental Sciences. Both posts: Knowledge of Konkani and 15 years Residence certificate; Knowledge of Marathi desirable. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Konkani is essential. All certificates must be valid on the last date for filing of application. Government servants must possess NOC of the employer.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who secure less than 04 marks in the Konkani test are not evaluated further. Candidates found ineligible at document verification are not considered even after passing the written examination. Soliciting or canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written examination (MCQ, 75 marks). Verification of documents. Selection strictly on marks in the written examination; no marks for Educational Qualifications. Equal marks: older date of birth first, then higher Educational Qualifications.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are filled on regular basis. Waiting list valid up to one year from the date of its preparation.
